hook: Interscope Records claims Summer Walker owes them $50 million in damages.

sections.voiceover: Interscope Records claims Summer Walker owes them $50 million in damages.

text_overlay.text: Interscope vs. Summer Walker: $50M at stake

sections.voiceover: In October, the label filed a 7-page lawsuit alleging the artist abandoned her 2017 contract. They claim she still owes two studio albums and an EP. Will this contract dispute reach a settlement?
Instead of settling, Summer Walker fired back with a 10-page cross-complaint.
Her filing demands at least $20 million from Interscope Records. Meanwhile, the label's partner, Love Renaissance Records, denied all allegations of fraud and breach of contract in court.
Both the $50 million claim and $20 million counter-demand remain unresolved.
